name: Bodyweight Single-Arm Standing Row
steps: Face a fixed wall opening and grasp its sturdy vertical edge with one hand.
Set your feet close to the wall, lean back with your arm straight and pull your ribs toward your hand.
Straighten your arm slowly to lean back again.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your shoulders square to the anchor rather than twisting open as you pull.
Keep your body rigid from head to heels and step closer to increase resistance.
